issues.on_page: Library Fund column: Public Works 78,518, Total Disbursements 78,518, Net Change 268

issues.on_page: Road Fund DISBURSEMENTS 1,559,521 (p4 splits it: Public Works 1,390,739, Principal Payments 120,019, Capital Outlay 48,763)
issues.issue: The whole one-line Road Fund disbursement total is categorized as streets/highways, even though p4 shows 120,019 of it is debt principal and 48,763 is capital outlay. This is a judgment call; the function mix isn't mentioned in notes.
The printed label is just 'Taxes'. The category is inferred from the fund name, while the same label is 'taxes (unlabeled)' everywhere else in the report. Defensible, but it is an assumption.

ending_cash 2,012,840 already includes these 500,000 of investments (cash 1,512,840 + investments 500,000). ending_investments is informational only, but beginning_investments is null, so the two years aren't comparable, and anyone adding investments to cash would count the 500,000 twice.
